safe_product_decisions.decision: One in-flight attempt per request owner, separate attempt UUID and scoped request identity. Completion must match active attempt before clearing current pending state.

Add explicit begin/pending/failure/accepted/cancelled states for an async adapter. Preserve a transaction snapshot on failure and permit deliberate retry without removing request at enqueue; do not describe retention, spinner, lock-all, or cancel styling as recovered native UI.

On request owner/key replacement invalidate/cancel the host attempt and ignore old receipt using account/host/connection/thread/request/attempt identity. Original request-key reset supports separate draft lifetimes but does not prove the original owner cancels exactly here.

Do not change original Send/Skip emptiness gate into unverified pending label or global disable layout. Exact busy UI/error subscriber must be closed first; any minimal host pending marker must be labelled independent.
